summary: Backend-only test of GET /api/health live Supabase probe. Both success (200) and failure (503) branches verified. Failure branch confirmed via manual curl when Supabase was still paused (returned HTTP 503 + correct body in ~0.6s). During pytest run the Supabase project became reachable again, so the 200 success branch was validated by 6 automated pytest cases (all passing). Response shape, no-secret-leakage, latency bound, socket-timeout restoration, and idempotency all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 22: create_client(SUPABASE_URL, SERVICE_KEY) is called at import time with no try/except. If SUPABASE_URL/SERVICE_KEY are unset or DNS fails at boot, the whole backend fails to start rather than surfacing the failure via /api/health. Consider lazy-init or wrapping in try/except so /api/health can still report 503.

server.py health(): socket.setdefaulttimeout(2.0) is a PROCESS-WIDE setting. While it's restored in finally, if another request lands in the same process during the ~sub-second window that /api/health is running, that concurrent request will also see a 2s socket timeout. In practice with uvicorn+threadpool this is a minor risk, but a per-call requests-level timeout on the supabase client (if the SDK supports it) would be safer than mutating the global default.

server.py health(): the underlying supabase-py call is synchronous but the endpoint is declared `def` (not `async def`) so FastAPI runs it in a threadpool — good, no event-loop blocking. Confirmed correct.
server.py: no rate-limiting on /api/health; if an uptime monitor pings aggressively while Supabase is down, each probe still opens a fresh connection attempt. Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Flyboy Supabase project was paused at the start of this iteration (returned HTTP 503 as designed) and became reachable partway through testing (now returns HTTP 200). The pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_health.py is state-aware — it accepts either 200 or 503 and asserts the correct response shape for each. All 6 tests pass in ~2.7s. If Supabase gets paused again in the future, the same tests will still pass and validate the 503 branch automatically.

manual_verification_evidence.followup_erasure_audit_after_health: HTTP 401 in ~0.4s — socket default timeout was properly restored
